name: mova-store
description: Open-source storefront with Stellar (Soroban) checkout — USDC/XLM escrow, Freighter wallet, and Supabase-backed catalog.

paragraphs: An open-source retail storefront built on the Stellar network

Mova Store is a reference-architecture e-commerce storefront that shows how a production-style online store can accept Stellar (Soroban) payments — USDC or native XLM paid directly from a customer's Freighter wallet into a Rust smart contract that escrows the funds until the order ships.

It is intentionally built as a real store, not a demo: Next.js storefront, product catalog, cart, email OTP flow, and a checkout that offers both traditional card payment and on-chain Stellar settlement with an order registry, escrow, and on-chain refunds. Teams and builders can use it as a blueprint for adding Soroban checkout to their own store.
features: Next.js 14 App Router + Tailwind CSS storefront (catalog, cart, checkout,
Soroban checkout with escrow — a Rust smart contract moves USDC (or
native XLM) from the buyer's wallet into an on-chain escrow, records the order, and releases it to the merchant on dispatch or refunds it on-chain.
Freighter wallet integration with network guard, pre-flight simulation,
readiness checks, real-time getEvents indexing, and an explorer link on success.
